title: GOP WEF, Palantir, and AIPAC network analysis — depth 2
summary: Official records establish a WEF–Palantir partner/event path, a Palantir-connected employee PAC contribution path, and separate AIPAC direct-PAC and independent-expenditure paths.

sources.title: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2026 partners
EMPLOYEES OF PALANTIR TECHNOLOGIES INC. PAC committee overview
AMERICAN ISRAEL PUBLIC AFFAIRS COMMITTEE POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE overview

methods: official WEF, FEC, LDA, and AIPAC record review

provenance.method: official-record graph extraction and bounded financial analysis

data.question: What WEF, Palantir political-money, and AIPAC-linked money paths recurse from the GOP graph?
data.method: Official WEF organization/event records, FEC committee summaries, LD-203 transactions, and a bounded secondary FEC-derived recipient lead.
data.framework: Partner/event participation, direct PAC contributions, connected-organization status, and independent expenditures are modeled as separate edge types.
data.scope: Palantir Technologies, Alex Karp, Palantir PAC, AIPAC, AIPAC PAC, and United Democracy Project.
findings: WEF lists Palantir as an Annual Meeting 2026 partner and published a 2026 session featuring Alex Karp.
Palantir PAC reported $84,000 in contributions to other committees through June 30, 2026; a 2025 LD-203 report identifies six Republican-linked contributions totaling $20,000.
AIPAC PAC reported $43,960,130.82 in contributions to other committees through June 30, 2026.
AIPAC describes United Democracy Project as AIPAC-backed; UDP reported $27,928,913.21 in independent expenditures through June 30, 2026.
conclusions: The WEF–Palantir links are documented partnership and event-participation links, not proof of ideological or policy control.
Palantir PAC and AIPAC PAC direct contributions should be resolved from itemized Schedule B filings.
UDP independent expenditures must be modeled separately from direct candidate donations and split into support, opposition, vendor, date, and amount edges.
recommendations: Resolve the full Palantir PAC recipient graph.
Verify the AIPAC PAC Republican recipient lead against official itemized FEC records.
Extract UDP Schedule E and 24/48-hour reports.
Expand historical WEF–Palantir links only from official records.
counterarguments: Committee totals can change after amended filings.
Financial support or event participation alone does not establish policy causation, control, or quid pro quo.
